description: Unresolved internal contradiction over the pending-verify sidecar's JSON shape. REQ-004's closing paragraph (behavioral-spec.md, the '★ FIXED after iteration-9 FIND-021' paragraph) states: 'The clip's caption text does NOT need to come from post_reel.py at all — run.sh already has the caption file path in hand ... so run.sh reads $CAP's content directly for the sidecar's "caption" field — no new plumbing needed for that part.' This explicitly asserts the sidecar JSON contains a 'caption' key populated from $CAP. However REQ-008 step 6 (the actual authoritative definition of the sidecar's shape) states the sidecar contains EXACTLY: '{"before_hrefs": [...stabilized before["hrefs"]...], "token": "#c<10-hex-random>"}' — two keys, no 'caption' key anywhere. This is not a stylistic ambiguity: verification-architecture.md's PROP-006(a) gives the literal fixture JSON the self-heal test seeds: '{"before_hrefs":["/aiclipsvault/reel/A/","/aiclipsvault/reel/B/"],"token":"#c4f2a91b7c"}' — confirming, in the one place meant to be unambiguous (a concrete test fixture), that there is NO caption key. REQ-004's sentence is dead text left over from an earlier (pre-iteration-8/10) design where matching was done against caption/hook PROSE and therefore needed the caption text persisted in the sidecar; that design was fully superseded by the token-substring match (REQ-008 step 6, iteration-8/10 redesign) which never reads or compares caption content at all. A builder implementing REQ-004 literally would write a 3-key sidecar that contradicts REQ-008's 2-key sidecar and PROP-006(a)'s literal test fixture, causing an immediate test failure or an implementer guessing which requirement is authoritative.

evidence.snippet: REQ-004: "so `run.sh` reads `$CAP`'s content directly for the sidecar's `"caption"` field" -- CONTRADICTS REQ-008 step 6: "a sidecar file ... containing `{"before_hrefs": [...], "token": "#c<10-hex-random>"}`" (no caption key), and verification-architecture.md:82's literal PROP-006(a) fixture `{"before_hrefs":[...],"token":"#c4f2a91b7c"}`
